headline: Export
institutionConfigHelp: These values are used in the export for attribution and record identification.
institutionNamePlaceholder: e.g. Museum of Art and History
institutionNameHelp: Official name of the holding institution (required for LIDO).
isilHelp: International standard identifier for libraries and museums. Prefixes the record ID if present.
locationHelp: City or location of the institution.
portalHostHelp: Base URL of the public catalogue. The LIDO export derives the direct record link from it.
recordRightsHelp: General license for the exported metadata records themselves (e.g. CC0 1.0 for aggregators like DDB/Europeana). Does not govern usage rights for the physical object or media.
ruleEditorEmpty: No source mapped to this target yet.
sourceFieldSearchPlaceholder: Search by field name or label…
sourceKindHelpAriaLabel: Explanation of source kind, relation type, direction, and role
sourceKindHelpFieldDesc: Takes the value directly from a field on the current record (e.g. title, description).
sourceKindHelpRelationDesc: Pulls the value from a linked record (e.g. the name of a linked person). Three additional settings control which link is used:
sourceKindHelpRelationTypeDesc: Which kind of link is considered (from the relation-type vocabulary; only entries compatible with the current record type are offered). Leave blank to allow any relation type.
sourceKindHelpDirectionDesc: Outbound: the current record is the source of the link (e.g. object → creator entity). Inbound: the current record is the target (e.g. object referenced by a procedure).
sourceKindHelpRoleDesc: Free-text label emitted alongside the name (e.g. as a role designation in the target format). Independent of the relation type.
sourceKindHelpExampleText: Event "Production / Creation", field "Involved Actor / Agent": relation type "created by", direction "Outbound" (the object points to the person), role "Painter". Result: the linked person's name appears as the actor, with "Painter" as an additional role designation in the event.
sourceKindHelpRecordDesc: A property of the record itself, independent of fields (e.g. internal ID, inventory number, portal URL).
sourceKindHelpConstantDesc: Fixed text emitted unchanged for every export.
sourceKindHelpMediaDesc: A property of an associated media file (e.g. URL, license, rights holder).
previewEmpty: Search for a reference record, then refresh the preview.
guidanceLidoEventCentric: A simple relation "Person ↔ Object" is not enough for LIDO: the role is decisive (e.g., "created by", "depicted person", "previous owner", "findspot", "part of").
guidanceLidoEvents: These statements primarily belong to events: production, discovery/find, acquisition, use, restoration, etc. An event brings actors, place, date/time, material/technique, and roles together.
guidanceLidoMappingSummary: In Katalon's data model, these are structured fields, entities, places, and typed relations. The LIDO exporter bundles them automatically into object, event, relation, and administrative metadata.
guidanceLidoCoreVsQuality: Object Work Type & Authorities: Katalon supports two paths for lido:objectWorkType: 1) Path A (Small institutions / fast data entry): Assign an AAT/GND concept to the subtype once under Configuration → Subtypes – the LIDO export automatically outputs conceptID and term. 2) Path B (Large institutions / granular classification): Create a schema field of type 'authority' (e.g. with Getty AAT) or 'vocab' and map it to objectWorkType (e.g. subtype Prints with field Object Type: Copper engraving).
guidanceDdbMdsIntro: This configuration is a practical starting point for DDB and Europeana. The current DDB MDS handbook remains authoritative.
guidanceDdbMdsInstitution: Set institution details: name, ISIL, and portal host.
guidanceDdbMdsTitleField: Map the object title to “Object Title”.
guidanceDdbMdsWorkType: Map the object type to “Object / Work Type”; prefer AAT/GND authority data.
guidanceDdbMdsProduction: Map creation date and creator as the “Production” event.
guidanceDdbMdsRights: Map the object’s rights status or license to “Rights Status / License”.
guidanceDdbMdsLink: Map a public media file to “Digital Resource” or set the portal host.
guidanceValidatorsDesc: To preserve server performance under load, Katalon does not perform synchronous, heavy XSD or Schematron validation on every exported XML record during live exports or OAI-PMH harvesting. Use the official aggregator validators to test schema conformance:
deleteLidoEventConfirmMessage: Do you really want to remove the event "{{name}}"? All mapped rules for this event will be deleted.
eventActorHelp: Artist, publisher, donor, finder or involved entity
eventDateHelp: Human-readable date statement for this event
eventEarliestDateHelp: Machine-readable earliest date boundary (for chronological sorting)
eventPlaceHelp: Location of the event (e.g. place of production, finding, acquisition)
eventMaterialsTechHelp: Statement on materials and production techniques (e.g. oil on canvas, bronze)
deleteModsElementConfirmMessage: Do you really want to remove the element "{{name}}"? All mapped rules for this element will be deleted.
